name: kitchensink4xl
description: Lets Claude work your Excel spreadsheets: cells, formulas, formatting, tables, and honest answers about which values are calculated, cached, or missing.
long_description: KitchenSink4XL connects Claude to your spreadsheets. Ask it to read and build tables, write formulas, format ranges, or import and export data. Every value it reports is labeled calculated, cached, or missing, and every change lands after an automatic backup. The server runs on your computer and KitchenSink4AI never receives your workbooks; your AI app handles what the server reads under its own settings. Part of the KitchenSink4 family (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Web) from KitchenSink4AI (kitchensink4.ai). macOS is untested in this release.

verify_with_excel.title: Verify every save with Excel
verify_with_excel.description: On: after each save, a hidden Excel checks that the file opens and recalculates cleanly. Slower, and the strongest guarantee; needs Excel installed.

allowed_root.title: Limit the server to one folder (optional)
allowed_root.description: Pick a folder and Claude can only touch spreadsheets inside it. Leave it empty for no limit.
